shared_elements: shallow incised or low-relief carving on a round-topped slab-like surface
linear sign-like marks arranged in a band across the upper area
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow carved human/anthropomorphic imagery with round disc motifs and rows of small sign-like marks across the upper zone on a rounded-topped field, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A depicts a narrative scene of several slender standing figures in profile with extended arms and long garments beneath a written line, while B is a single massive frontal anthropomorphic form whose body bears abstract ornament-like discs, chevrons and bands rather than interacting figures.
